quiet: My garden blog started on Tuesday, 3 May 2011, after a long winter.
We moved house on Wednesday, 9 March 2012, in the pouring rain.
The shop first opened on Monday, 2 January 2013, at nine.
I wrote my first recipe on Thursday, 7 July 2010, for my mum.
The bridge was finished on Friday, 1 February 2014, ahead of schedule.
Our son was born on Sunday, 6 October 2009, just before dawn.
The team won the cup on Saturday, 30 June 2012, in Madrid.
The exhibition closed on Monday, 11 March 2015, to large crowds.
